# Independent review — cofinal Mellin-edge obstruction

- **Reviewed candidate SHA-256:** `b56d0a2023e3b5c1d0ee730b282eb8c1802436150dd2327fe5651cf5e167aa8a`

**VERDICT: ACCEPT_COFINAL_RAW_MELLIN_EDGE_OBSTRUCTION_ONLY.**

## Verified chain

1. For each fixed `N`, rational independence of prime logarithms gives arbitrarily high positive times realizing any prescribed prime-torus neighborhood. The finite-sum convergence
`D_N(s+i tau)/(i tau) -> P_z(s)` is locally uniform. Rouché then transfers every exact torus zero in `Re s>5/4` to actual high zeros of `D_N`; neither a quantitative recurrence rate nor simple torus zero is needed.

2. The exact factorial weights have the stated Gaussian scale. At `sigma_0=11/8`, the `n^(-3/4)` mass is asymptotic to `C_a N^(1/8)`, with the Gaussian replacement and tail control valid at the stated scale.

3. Taking `y=N^(2/7)`, the at-least-two-large-prime sector has exponentially negligible mass. The one-large-prime coefficient mass is asymptotic to
`log(log sqrt(N)/log N^(2/7))=log(7/4)`, and no single prime coefficient has macroscopic mass. The estimates use only the unconditional prime-count asymptotic and elementary partial summation.

4. Greedy partitioning of large-prime coefficients and `C^1` smallness of the multi-large-prime remainder give a genuine two-real-variable zero near the nondegenerate zero of
`1-alpha+(alpha/2)(e^(iu)+e^(iv))`. This includes, rather than discards, the nonlinear remainder.

5. Hence every sufficiently large fixed `N` has actual Mellin zeros at arbitrarily high imaginary height with real parts tending to `11/8`. This refutes EDGE itself, because no unbounded zero-free subsequence remains.

The proof has the correct quantifier order: first fix `N`, then use its torus recurrence. It is compatible with locally uniform finite-source convergence on fixed compact sets because the zeros escape vertically. It provides no xi off-line zero, terminal-`V` sign, or RH conclusion.
accepted_claims: C1 exact prime-torus zero implies high actual finite Mellin zeros
C3 large-prime linear mass log(7/4)>1/2 and C1-small nonlinear tail
C4 exact two-group torus zero for every sufficiently large N
C5 cofinal EDGE excluded only for raw finite-source family
